name: neon
description: Applies Finnomena's brand theme so any employee's vibe-coded apps and UI mockups automatically follow company branding, with a choice of depth: CSS-only colors/typography or the full Coinbase Design System (CDS). Ships neon-audit (recommends a theming depth for an existing project), neon-redesign (colors/typography via CSS variables, no CDS), and neon-create (full CDS — scaffolds a new project or themes an existing one).
